· UNIDO, who provided support in the organisation of the conference, expressed a willingness to 
co-sponsor a follow-on workshop in Europe to cover the financing and investment aspects of SHP 
in less-developed countries.  
· The project team have agreed to maintain this successful EU-China collaboration and to prepare 
project proposals in the future to develop more concrete links and, in particular, to initiate 
technology transfer projects. One priority area was identified as being control system technology.
